Set ns=3;s="dbVar"."Err"."xQuit" true on PressPLC (work cell 1: press tending). acknowledge the station's fault so it can be started again. Writes `dbVar.Err.xQuit`, which is the input the station's own configuration names -- not the module's `xReset`.
true unless the bit is being cleared; defaults to true
whether the write was acknowledged

Set ns=3;s="dbVar"."RemoteControlAutomatic_Start" true on PressPLC (work cell 1: press tending). start the station in automatic mode. This is the remote-control input; it is not the module's internal `xStart`, which a remote caller is not meant to drive and which four writes moved nothing with.
true unless the bit is being cleared; defaults to true
whether the write was acknowledged

Static Festo business linkage. The MES endpoint and stable line codes identify the equipment; query OpenMES for current orders, IDs and schedules. Instantiation rebinds the maintenance submodel to the new instance.

submodelElements.value: One Festo device, Cell 1, one unstarted production order. Default maintenance to the day after the later of the original production date and current MES local date, retaining the original production start time, with at least 180 minutes reserved. Postpone production until the persisted maintenance end plus one day (24 hours) of planning allowance. Apply the approved schedule immediately while maintenance is pending. Preserve quantity and production duration. No backup resource or replacement order.

value.text: DEMO FICTION: a pneumatic connector leak lowers synthetic pressure from 6.0 bar; below 4.8 bar for 3 seconds raises the scenario alarm. These are not calibrated PLC limits. The reference describes a press controlled through RevPi and a turning-over module controlled through a microcontroller, each communicating with a Siemens PLC. Ask the qualified operator to assess readiness and communication using the approved site procedure. Do not infer a root cause or send reset/start commands.
